task.title: To insert a clause from Clause Library into a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.

In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clause Library. The list of all the available clauses is displayed. To view the complete clause name, either hover the mouse over the clause name or expand the X-Author for Contracts Advanced window.

You can use the Search by Clause Name box to search a clause by keyword. Click the Filter button () to view the drop-down menus that can help you to refine your search according to Type, Category, Subcategory, Locale, and Language.

note.p: You can configure custom locales in Conga CLM on the Conga platform.

step.cmd: Place the cursor in the section of the template where you want to insert a clause.

Click a clause from the list to view the clause text and active version. To insert the clause, click the Expand button () next to the clause name and click Insert this Clause to insert the clause into your template as inline text. You see a success message on inserting a clause. The clause content is marked by a content control boundary in your template. The inserted clause is now displayed in the Clauses Menu. For more information on Clauses Menu, see About Clauses Menu.

ul.li: When you insert a clause using the Insert this Clause option, the clause takes the format of the document. For example, if you are inserting a plain text clause inside a bulleted list, the clause takes the format of the bulleted list.
You can insert a delete read-only clauses into your template. Delete read-only clauses can only be deleted in the Doc Clauses tab.
You cannot search and insert an alternate clause from the Clause Library.
